summary:
Reviewed PR #22 (base 96a6dca → head 9043e57): 37 files / 57 diff chunks, all read and assessed. The change adds a `cephalon_diagnostic` CI gate plus a new read-only deployment diagnostic (`scripts/verify_cephalon_local.cljs`), its fixture-based test namespace, kanban cards/notes/evidence snapshots, and append-only receipt/ledger entries.

Deterministic evidence: all 13 gates succeeded — workspace_laws (24 tests/120 assertions), project/lineage/evidence laws, contracts, migration-pack and receipt-history checks (250 receipts / 51 appends at head, reconciled against the 199-receipt base), and cephalon_diagnostic (12 tests / 93 assertions, 0 failures). The opencode-lint and jscpd `spawn ENOENT` lines inside workspace_laws are runner-environment tool absences, not change-introduced failures.

Confirmed findings: none. One candidate (physical-field card names b5f2ba9e as a proposed predecessor in prose but omits it from frontmatter `dependency:`) was validated and rejected: the card itself declares the UUID a proposed relationship and assigns enforcement to the epic's separate dependency-admission gate, no changed code consumes frontmatter for admission, and sibling cards document that proposed edges are deliberately not added to established frontmatter.

Non-blocking notes: (1) the PR body's scope claims (head `4f1ad49`, 31 paths, 249/50 receipts) are stale relative to the actual head (37 files, 250/51) — the body is not part of the staged diff, so no inline finding; (2) diagnostic 60s docker-exec timeout could exceed worst-case sequential fetch timeouts but fails closed; (3) 6 evidence/card files present in the diff are not itemized in the PR body's changed-path list. No test gaps requiring inline findings.

Docs / diagnostic script start: transition into scripts/verify_cephalon_local.cljs. The new script is read-only by design (docker exec observations + HTTP GETs), fail-closed ordering (image check → manifest validation → hash checks → exec), no network at test import time (top-level IIFE guarded). Reviewed full file earlier; no defect.

scripts/verify_cephalon_local.cljs continued: verify!/observation-script/command! implementation. Fail-closed throws before exec; command! throws on nonzero; observation script wraps all in try/catch → exitCode=1. 60s docker-exec timeout vs 10s fetch timeouts could exceed but fails closed — environment robustness, not a defect.

test/verify_cephalon_local_test.cljs start: fixture helpers (inspect-fixture etc.). Tests stub diagnostic/command! and deployment via with-redefs — no real Docker/network/mongodb in CI; top-level guard prevents script auto-exec at import. 12 tests/93 assertions pass per deterministic log. No defect.

test file continued: observe-query-fixture with isolated HTTP/Mongo boundaries (in-memory cursor, fixture fetch/require). Non-array-feed failure-continuation and query-filter-before-limit tests. Deterministic, no real I/O; assertion of 'Failures: 1' matches fail-closed contract. No defect.

test file continued: scheduled-run-query-filters-before-the-recent-limit test asserts exact query map and call order [:find :sort :limit :to-array] with retained-clock row only — validates filter-before-limit contract. Custom test/report :end-run-tests sets exitCode 1 on failures (correct multi-namespace aggregation). No defect.
test file end: (test/run-tests 'verify-cephalon-local-test) — entry point for the nbb test namespace. Matches deterministic log (12 tests/93 assertions, exit 0). No defect.
